rows.membership_metric: none (axis-aligned pixel box; no learned/data membership)
rows.support_note: broad-ball witnesses in-cube but off-manifold; per-pair Lipschitz ~19x real baseline in the LARD analogue; on TinyTaxiNet the mean-constrained ball admits 707/893 excursions beyond the +-10 m envelope.

rows.membership_metric: same-class K=100 nearest-neighbour per-pixel extent (data-conditioned box)
rows.support_note: box extent is data-conditioned but per-pixel independence still admits off-manifold corners: witness classifier prob median ~0.01, 17/20 below 0.1.
